historical_references.reference: Poresh was a chief of the Sesodia Rajputs, who ruled over the region of Marwar in present-day Rajasthan, India. He is believed to have lived during the late 12th or early 13th century.
historical_references.context: Ruler of the Sesodia Rajputs in Marwar

historical_references.reference: Poresh was a trusted general of Prithviraj Chauhan III, the last Hindu ruler of Delhi, during his wars against the invading Mongols led by Genghis Khan in 1221 AD. He lost his life while defending the fort of Takht-i-Sultan against Genghis Khan's forces.
historical_references.context: Trusted general of Prithviraj Chauhan III during wars against Mongols
